svg.title: At load time, a text column is sent through an in-cluster embedding model and the vectors are written beside each data file. At query time, the query string is embedded once, the vectors of files that survive pruning and filters are scanned with an exact distance, and the top results are returned.
svg.text: a pruned file takes its vectors with it

figure.figcaption: Embeddings are a column the engine owns. Load once; at query time, embed the question and scan what survives pruning.
